blocks.text: Our IT provider will carry out maintenance on the firm's email and file servers over the holiday weekend, beginning after close of business on Thursday and, we are told, finishing before the start of business on Monday. During that window, mail may arrive late and the shared drive and remote access may be unavailable for stretches, although anything saved on your own laptop will be unaffected.

Please save and close any files you have open on the shared drive before you sign off on Thursday. If you expect to need the drive or your mailbox over the weekend, let me know by tomorrow afternoon so that we can ask the provider to work around it.
